creative_objective: Carry the emotion with one first-person sentence of a woman who stopped being 'the skinny one of the group', show her before moment with loose jeans and her result in a small inset, show the three-bottle treatment and close with the fixed offer and 'Pagas al recibir'.

art_direction.visual_hierarchy: 1) The giant quote on the top left; 2) the photo card on the top right; 3) the three bottles on the lower right; 4) the value proposition and the red offer pill on the left; 5) the round yellow badge on the bottom left.
art_direction.composition_style: Same as reference mv-27 (adapted to square): big white serif quote in four lines on the upper left, the bottles standing on the right over a dark colored background with soft light, offer text in the middle left, a round badge at the bottom left. Added on the upper right (mandatory in this app): a photo card with the before scene and a small result inset.
art_direction.spacing_and_structure: Left column 56 % of width: quote 4-42 % of height, value proposition 44-56 %, offer pill 60-68 %, round badge 72-96 %. Right column 44 %: photo card 4-58 % of height, bottles 52-95 %.
art_direction.lighting_and_depth: Dark cocoa background with a soft radial amber #9A4F12 glow behind the bottles; bottles lit by a warm softbox from the upper left with gentle rim light on the glass and short soft shadows on a dark matte surface; daylight inside the photo card.

reference_structure_analysis.layout_summary: Reference: dark green gradient background. Upper left, a first-person exclamation in large white serif over four lines (45 %). Right, two amber dropper bottles standing side by side, slightly overlapping, lit softly. Middle left, the unit offer in white uppercase sans-serif over three lines. Bottom left, a solid green circle with the discount percentage in serif and a line under it. Adaptation: background in deep cocoa; quote in Spanish without a name; three bottles (the 3-month treatment) instead of two; the offer becomes the red pill with the fixed treatment text; the discount circle becomes the round bordered yellow 'Pagas al recibir' badge (no discount exists); a photo card with the before scene and the result inset is added on the upper right.

RIGHT COLUMN (58-96 % of width): UPPER RIGHT (4-58 % of height): one rounded photo card (corner radius 16 px, 2 px gold #C9962B border), a realistic smartphone photo of a real young Colombian woman, about 26, light-brown skin with visible pores and a few freckles, dark-brown hair in a loose high ponytail with flyaway strands, no makeup, a light sweat sheen, grey sports top and light-blue jeans one size too big, standing sideways to the camera at the gym locker-room door with a gym bag on her shoulder, camera at hip height from the side, framed from the head to the knees, face turned to the lens with a frustrated, tired look; with one hand she pulls the back of the jeans waistband a full fist away from her lower back so the empty gap between denim and body is clearly visible, a baggy fold of extra denim below the seat, drooping back pockets, one straight flat vertical line from waist to thigh, thin straight thighs with loose fabric: flat, no curve, no volume. (60mL)', the front label fully legible; warm softbox key light from the upper left, gentle rim light, matte, no rainbow, no lens flare, short soft shadows.
